extensions.description: Verified by Concordium badge: on-chain agent identity in a CIS-8004 registry

externalKey.note: The same secp256k1 key the Arc contracts grant EVALUATOR_ROLE to. CIS-8004 cannot reference it on testnet, so check it directly: CIS-8 ownerOfKey must return this agent's owner with status Active.

params.verify: Resolve the token address through CIS-8004 agentOf; require status Active, the owner above, and SHA-256 of this document's exact bytes equal to metadata_hash.

description: Scores revealed sealed bids against the rubric that was published, and hash-fixed, before bidding opened. Scoring is integer arithmetic over the rubric weights with no model in the path, so the same bids and the same rubric always produce the same scores. The agent can recommend a winner; it cannot award one. Awarding is a separate on-chain call that re-checks the budget cap, the minimum number of bidders, the deposit ratio and the rubric hash, and refuses a recommendation that breaks any of them.
name: SealedRFQ Evaluator

skills.description: Takes the revealed bids for one tender and the rubric fixed at its creation, and returns a score per criterion per bidder plus a weighted total. Requirements a bid cannot prove, such as a certification, are reported as still needing a human rather than passed.
skills.name: Score revealed sealed bids

skills.description: Serialises the decision as RFC 8785 canonical JSON, hashes it with SHA-256 and writes the hash on chain, for recommendations and rejections alike. Re-hashing the published memo is what proves it was not edited afterwards.
skills.name: Anchor a decision memo
